text.aria-label: Title text 'Stamp offsets from sunrise and sunset ramps: no 30-minute error'

g.text: Stamp offsets from sunrise and sunset ramps: no 30-minute error

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Blue: rows before the fix, April to September; orange: rows after the fix. Each mark: the mean of the morning-ramp and evening-ramp offsets that best match the change of net power to the change of sun height on clear-sky days, in minutes the stored stamps run late. Grey lines: 0 (the stamps are right) and +30 (the feed as NGED sent it before 2026-03-26 08:30 UTC). Crosses: a ramp hit the search limit (100 minutes or more), so the estimate is not reliable. The six metered PV series are shown as one median with the range of their estimates.'
text.tspan: Blue: rows before the fix, April to September; orange: rows after the fix. Each mark: the mean
of the morning-ramp and evening-ramp offsets that best match the change of net power to the
change of sun height on clear-sky days, in minutes the stored stamps run late. Grey lines: 0
(the stamps are right) and +30 (the feed as NGED sent it before 2026-03-26 08:30 UTC). Crosses:
a ramp hit the search limit (100 minutes or more), so the estimate is not reliable. The six
metered PV series are shown as one median with the range of their estimates.
